description: Patent litigation cross-reference: a named US district-court case to its docket, its asserted patent NUMBERS, and its defendants. Pass a case name (e.g. "TurboCode LLC v. Quectel Wireless Solutions") or a docket_id already known from search_dockets. Patent numbers come ONLY from text CourtListener/RECAP already indexes — the clerk's own docket-entry descriptions (e.g. an exhibit filed as "United States Patent No. 6,813,742") and the text of any document someone else has already purchased from PACER — never from buying a PACER document. Each patent number says exactly which filing it was found in and the label that preceded it, and carries USPTO patent metadata (title, status, grant date, inventor) when a platform USPTO key is configured — the number is still returned without one. Defendants come from the case caption CourtListener indexed, not an authenticated PACER party list, and say so. This is a thin cross-reference: a patent asserted only inside an unpurchased complaint PDF, or a defendant list CourtListener truncated with "et al.", will not be complete here — the response names that gap rather than hiding it.

examples.case_name: TurboCode LLC v. Quectel Wireless Solutions

case_name.description: Case name, e.g. "TurboCode LLC v. Quectel Wireless Solutions". Required unless docket_id is given.

court.description: Optional court filter when searching by case_name (e.g. "txed" for E.D. Texas).

docket_id.description: Docket id already known from search_dockets. Skips the case-name lookup.

filing_limit.description: How many docket filings to scan for patent numbers (default 50, max 100).

name: find_case_patents
title: Find Case Patents
